meta.title: Jilebi — Authentic Indian Restaurant in Nürtingen
meta.description: Hand-crafted Indian cooking in the heart of Nürtingen. Reserve a table online in two steps.

hero.headline: A little India.
hero.tagline: Gather around. Discover the warmth of Indian cooking, right here in the heart of Nürtingen.
hero.image_alt: Butter chicken with cream and fresh coriander, served with naan beside a sunlit window

about.label: Our Story
about.title: From our kitchen,
about.body: The warmth of the tandoor. The fragrance of freshly ground spices. Recipes passed from one generation to the next. At Jilebi, we bring the food we love to the place we call home, with fresh ingredients and a generous welcome.
about.image_alt: Warmly lit interior of Jilebi restaurant
about.intro: Some meals stay with you. We make those.
about.caption: Your evening, a little warmer.

menu.label: Our Kitchen
menu.title: Follow your
menu.intro: A little heat, a little sweetness, a world of flavour. Find your favourite, or discover something new.
menu.footnote: Questions about ingredients or allergens? We are happy to help.

image_alt.starters: Golden samosas filled with potatoes and peas, served with mint chutney
image_alt.mains: Butter chicken with a swirl of cream and fresh coriander
image_alt.drinks: A glass of creamy mango lassi with cardamom and fresh mango
